root_cause.text: The compiler inserts one byte of tail padding after `struct virtio_net_rss_config_trailer` within `struct virtnet_info`, causing a one-byte misalignment between the flexible array member `rss_trailer.hash_key_data` and the subsequent `rss_hash_key_data` array.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "due to tail padding in flexible `struct virtio_net_rss_config_trailer`, `rss_trailer.hash_key_data` (at offset 83 in struct virtnet_info) and `rss_hash_key_data` (at offset 84 in struct virtnet_info) are misaligned by one byte," which shifts the RSS key passed to the device by one byte. The patch resolves this by using the `TRAILING_OVERLAP()` helper to overlay `rss_hash_key_data` onto the flexible array member and adding a `static_assert` to ensure they align.
